description: This file defines a Doctrine ORM entity class 'WorkflowStateMachine' representing a workflow state machine for Human Resource Management processes, including properties for workflow attributes and constants for various actions and flow types.

classes.name: WorkflowStateMachine
classes.description: An entity class mapped to 'ohrm_workflow_state_machine' table, modeling different workflow states and actions related to HR processes.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the workflow state machine record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the workflow state machine record.

methods.name: getWorkflow
methods.description: Returns the name of the workflow.

methods.name: setWorkflow
methods.description: Sets the name of the workflow.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the action to be performed.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the action to be performed.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Returns the resulting state after performing the action.

methods.name: setResultingState
methods.description: Sets the resulting state after performing the action.

methods.name: getRolesToNotify
methods.description: Returns roles to notify, if any.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the workflow state.
